category: hosted SMS and voice API provider with a free trial credit and a DEMO mode; paid plans are usage based

free_tier.stated: EUR 2 free test credit on signup, with the account in DEMO mode; trial SMS is limited to the registered number and four verified test numbers and carries a [FREE SMS DEMO, TEST MESSAGE] notice; no credit card required
free_tier.notes: The test credit is denominated in euros. One first-party guide states up to 10 destination numbers in DEMO mode while two support articles state the registered number plus four verified test numbers; both figures are quoted in evidence. No credit card is required at signup.

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: the API reference pages read state no hard numeric limit on SMS message length; an over-long message returns error code 12 'Message Too Long'

retention.stated: not applicable to stored bytes: messages are delivered and can be looked up, but no explicit message-log retention period is stated on the pages read; SMS delivery is attempted by default for 72 hours, typically 24 to 48 hours

egress.terms: Outbound SMS and voice calls are the metered service itself; the pricing page lists USD 0.00860 per US LVN SMS message and USD 0.01538 per voice minute, with carrier fees added. SMS delivery attempts run for up to 72 hours by default.
egress.free_allowance: EUR 2 free test credit in DEMO mode

interface_detail: A REST SMS API at rest.nexmo.com with an OpenAPI specification, plus Messages, Voice and Pricing APIs, authenticated with an API key and secret; a Vonage CLI, language SDKs and inbound and outbound webhooks are documented. SMPP is also listed as an option. The Pricing API is rate limited to one request per second.
tooling: Vonage CLI, language SDKs, the REST API with an OpenAPI description, the Account Dashboard and inbound webhook endpoints
chaining: Transactional SMS and voice for alerts and two-factor authentication; the Verify API adds OTP delivery with voice fallback, and webhooks feed delivery and inbound events into a larger stack.

limits.value: EUR 2 free test credit on signup in DEMO mode
trial SMS only to the registered number and four verified test numbers; voice calls only to the registered number
trial credit cannot be used to buy virtual phone numbers
DEMO mode requires target numbers to be added to a whitelisted destination list
Pricing API rate limited to one request per second
SMS delivery attempted for up to 72 hours by default, typically 24 to 48 hours

limits_note: First-party pages disagree on the trial destination count: two support articles say the registered number plus four verified test numbers (or up to 5 test numbers), while the account getting-started guide says up to 10 destination numbers. Both figures are quoted in evidence.
binding_note: The DEMO mode destination whitelist and the ban on buying virtual numbers with trial credit restrict what the account can send to before the EUR 2 credit is used up.

identity_cost.detail: The sign-up page lists Email, First name, Last name, Password and Phone number and the steps Verify email and Verify number. It states 'No credit card required.' and 'We need a verified number in order to prevent misuse of our services and fraud.' The account guide adds company information and a PIN sent to the phone by text message or automated call, with one phone number per account. A verified phone number is required and no card is asked for; for very few countries Vonage cannot create an account automatically.

reliability_note: The SMS API answers error 1 when sending faster than the account limit, error 9 when credit is insufficient and error 29 for non-whitelisted destinations in demo mode; inbound webhooks are retried for 24 hours without a 2xx answer.
confidence_note: Values are quoted from first-party signup, documentation and support pages. No account was opened, so any value visible only after signup is unverified.

notes: Vonage was formerly Nexmo. The free offer is a DEMO mode trial with a [FREE SMS DEMO, TEST MESSAGE] notice on SMS. A verified phone number is required at signup and no card is required. For very few countries Vonage cannot create an account automatically. The trial destination count differs between first-party pages (5 versus 10); both figures are quoted and the conflict is left open rather than resolved.
